Questions about pricing
Price plans, payments and payouts
How do price plans work?

Your price plan sets how quickly you get paid out and your transaction fees. We've introduced three new price plans with new pricing: Next Day from 1.87%, Two Days from 1.77%, and Five Days from 1.67%, for standard cards on Terminal. Payouts on the new price plans go out Monday to Saturday, and every new account now starts on the Five Days plan.

If you're still on one of our earlier price plans, Weekly Legacy or Two Days Legacy, your rates stay the same. When you're ready, you can switch to any of the new price plans your account qualifies for.
You'll need to be on one of the new price plans to be able to order a Terminal. Each price plan has features and add-ons that are individually priced
You can switch from Price plans in the Nomod app or Dashboard. Every new account starts on the Five Days plan, and once your account qualifies, you can also switch to Two Days or Next Day.

If you're still on one of our earlier price plans, Weekly Legacy or Two Days Legacy, you can switch to any of the new price plans your account qualifies for: Next Day, Two Days or Five Days. Once you switch, the earlier price plans will no longer be available to you.
Any payments you took before switching will still be paid out on your previous plan's schedule
Your payouts depend on your price plan. On the new price plans, your charges are paid out the next day, in two days or in five days. Payouts go out Monday to Saturday, except UAE public holidays.

If you're still on one of our earlier price plans, Weekly Legacy or Two Days Legacy, your payout schedule stays the same: business days, Monday to Friday. Weekly Legacy pays out in five business days and Two Days Legacy in two business days.
The minimum payout on each price plan is AED 200.
How do I get access to custom pricing?

Install and activate the Nomod for WooCommerce plugin – In your WordPress admin dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Nomod for WooCommerce,” click Install Now, and then Activate.

Configure the Nomod plugin in WooCommerce – In your WordPress dashboard, go to WooCommerce > Settings, click on the Payments tab, and select Nomod from the list of payment methods. Click Manage, enable the payment method, and paste your API Key into the designated field.
